title: Hunger After All the Worlds
narrativeSpine: A novel-atlas couples encounters with a periodic grammar of speculative operations, preserving intellectual genealogy and the otherness of inhabited worlds.
firstSceneDraft: Hunger After All the Worlds combines a novel with an atlas of speculation.
Its powerful world-makers face a problem that greater capability cannot automatically solve.
How can imagination encounter something it has not already reduced to itself?
The book explores that tension through inhabited worlds and a revisable conceptual table.
visualActionProposal: A memorial threshold opens into a lived city; a classifier tries to close its cell while a resident’s divergent path extends beyond the proposed boundary.
